DIAGNOSIS READY: Intracranial Mass (likely Glioblastoma Multiforme or Metastasis) causing increased intracranial pressure and optic nerve compression.

I have noted your age and the three-week progression of headache and vision loss without systemic symptoms like fever or weight change.
